Construct a known LTI system for Signals and Systems, identify it from impulse, frequency, and input-output evidence, and quantify how sampling, truncation, and nonlinearity break the model.

zh: 系统方程、传递函数/状态空间和测试信号设计说明
生成、辨识、卷积/变换与绘图的可执行 notebook
原始输入输出、冲激响应、频率响应和残差数据
一份报告，比较三种模型并分析混叠、泄漏、截断和非线性失败
en: A specification of system equations, transfer function or state space, and test-signal design
An executable notebook for generation, identification, convolution or transforms, and plotting
Raw input-output, impulse-response, frequency-response, and residual data
A report comparing three model views and analyzing aliasing, leakage, truncation, and nonlinear failure

zh: 无噪声基线中，重建输出的归一化 RMSE 低于 1%
对 DC、Nyquist 附近、有限记录和幅度饱和四个边界案例给出预期与实测
证明时域卷积与频域相乘在数值容差 1e-8 内一致
注入一个时变或非线性项，量化残差相对 LTI 基线至少 3 倍的增长
en: Achieve normalized reconstruction RMSE below 1% on the noiseless baseline
Document expected and observed behavior at DC, near Nyquist, with finite records, and under amplitude saturation
Show time-domain convolution and frequency-domain multiplication agree within 1e-8
Inject a time-varying or nonlinear term and quantify at least threefold residual growth over the LTI baseline

zh: 提交模型、信号生成、辨识、测试和绘图源文件
固定采样率、记录长度、窗函数、依赖版本和随机种子
保存原始波形与中间变换，报告从原始数据一键重建
en: Commit model, signal-generation, identification, test, and plotting sources
Pin sample rate, record length, window, dependencies, and random seeds
Preserve raw waveforms and intermediate transforms and rebuild the report from raw data with one command

safety_note.zh: 只使用合成信号和软件模型；若另行接入硬件，必须重新评估电压、接地、采样与执行器风险。
safety_note.en: Use synthetic signals and software models only; any later hardware connection requires a fresh assessment of voltage, grounding, acquisition, and actuator risks.

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Introduction to EECS II: Digital Communication Systems · MIT 6.02》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。为通信系统仿真发射、信道、同步、检测和误码统计的完整基带链路，量化 SNR、频偏、时偏和多径影响。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Introduction to EECS II: Digital Communication Systems · MIT 6.02, not an official course assignment. Simulate a complete baseband chain for Communication Systems, including transmit, channel, synchronization, detection, and error statistics, and quantify SNR, carrier offset, timing offset, and multipath effects.

zh: 调制、帧结构、信道、同步器和检测器的系统规格与链路预算
发送机、信道、接收机、基线检测器和测试源代码
每个 SNR 至少 100 个误码或 1e6 比特的原始计数、同步轨迹与星座
一份报告，比较理论/仿真 BER 并解释同步阈值和误差地板
en: A system specification and link budget for modulation, framing, channel, synchronizer, and detector
Transmitter, channel, receiver, baseline detector, and test sources
Raw counts, synchronization traces, and constellations with at least 100 errors or 1e6 bits per SNR
A report comparing theoretical and simulated BER and explaining synchronization thresholds and error floors

zh: AWGN 标称链路的 BER 置信区间覆盖理论曲线，或解释有限样本偏差

Raw counts, synchronization traces, and constellations with at least 100 errors or 1e6 bits per SNR
A report comparing theoretical and simulated BER and explaining synchronization thresholds and error floors

zh: AWGN 标称链路的 BER 置信区间覆盖理论曲线，或解释有限样本偏差
覆盖零信号、低 SNR、高 SNR、半符号时偏和指定频偏边界
用第二个独立调制解调实现交叉核对至少 1000 个无噪声符号
逐步增加频偏或多径，报告同步首次失锁点与 BER 退化
en: For the nominal AWGN link, make BER confidence intervals cover the theoretical curve or explain finite-sample bias
Cover zero signal, low and high SNR, half-symbol timing offset, and a declared carrier-offset boundary
Cross-check at least 1,000 noiseless symbols with an independent modem implementation
Increase carrier offset or multipath gradually and report the first synchronization-loss point and BER degradation

zh: 提交链路模块、配置、测试、理论计算和绘图源文件

Pin sample rate, frame length, seeds, channel parameters, and dependency versions
Preserve per-frame raw counts and traces and generate the report automatically from configuration

title.zh: 《Information Theory · Stanford University EE 276》信源/信道编码边界实验
title.en: Information Theory · Stanford University EE 276: Source/Channel Coding Boundary Experiment

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Information Theory · Stanford University EE 276》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。围绕信息论与编码实现一个压缩或纠错编码器，在有限块长下比较熵/容量理论界、实际码率、失真和误码。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Information Theory · Stanford University EE 276, not an official course assignment. Implement a compression or error-correcting code for Information Theory and Coding and compare entropy or capacity bounds with finite-blocklength rate, distortion, and error.

zh: 信源/信道模型、码构造、块长、码率和理论界推导
编码器、译码器、随机基线和单元测试源文件
至少 5 个块长或噪声点的原始码长、失真、误码和运行时
一份报告，比较理论界与实现并分析短块、突发错误或模型失配
en: A derivation of source or channel model, code construction, block length, rate, and theoretical bound
Encoder, decoder, random baseline, and unit-test sources
Raw code length, distortion, error, and runtime across at least five block lengths or noise points
A report comparing theory and implementation and analyzing short blocks, burst errors, or model mismatch

zh: 无噪声编码往返对至少 10000 个随机消息逐位一致
实测平均码率不低于熵界且差距随块长增加按预期缩小
用穷举小块长或第二个实现交叉核对译码最优性
注入突发错误或错误先验，报告相对独立同分布基线的性能退化
en: Round-trip at least 10,000 random messages bit-exactly in the noiseless case
Keep measured average rate above the entropy bound and show the gap shrinking with block length as expected
Cross-check decoding optimality by exhaustive small-block search or a second implementation
Inject burst errors or a mismatched prior and report degradation relative to the IID baseline

zh: 提交推导、编解码、基线、测试与绘图源文件
固定块长、码本生成规则、种子、停止准则与依赖
保存逐块原始结果、失败消息和自动生成报告
en: Commit derivation, codec, baseline, test, and plotting sources
Pin block lengths, codebook generation, seeds, stopping rules, and dependencies
Preserve per-block raw results, failed messages, and the generated report

safety_note.zh: 仅使用合成比特流；不得把未经独立验证的编码器用于紧急通信、医疗遥测或安全关键存储。
safety_note.en: Use synthetic bitstreams only; do not deploy the unvalidated codec to emergency communications, medical telemetry, or safety-critical storage.

summary.zh: MIT 的《Information Theory》以讲义补充信息论学习；文本可作参考，但没有公开视频、答案或考试，不能独立构成反馈闭环。

title.zh: 《Information Theory · MIT 6.441》信源/信道编码边界实验
title.en: Information Theory · MIT 6.441: Source/Channel Coding Boundary Experiment

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Information Theory · MIT 6.441》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。围绕信息论与编码实现一个压缩或纠错编码器，在有限块长下比较熵/容量理论界、实际码率、失真和误码。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Information Theory · MIT 6.441, not an official course assignment. Implement a compression or error-correcting code for Information Theory and Coding and compare entropy or capacity bounds with finite-blocklength rate, distortion, and error.

zh: 信源/信道模型、码构造、块长、码率和理论界推导
编码器、译码器、随机基线和单元测试源文件
至少 5 个块长或噪声点的原始码长、失真、误码和运行时
一份报告，比较理论界与实现并分析短块、突发错误或模型失配
en: A derivation of source or channel model, code construction, block length, rate, and theoretical bound
Encoder, decoder, random baseline, and unit-test sources
Raw code length, distortion, error, and runtime across at least five block lengths or noise points
A report comparing theory and implementation and analyzing short blocks, burst errors, or model mismatch

zh: 无噪声编码往返对至少 10000 个随机消息逐位一致
实测平均码率不低于熵界且差距随块长增加按预期缩小
用穷举小块长或第二个实现交叉核对译码最优性
注入突发错误或错误先验，报告相对独立同分布基线的性能退化
en: Round-trip at least 10,000 random messages bit-exactly in the noiseless case
Keep measured average rate above the entropy bound and show the gap shrinking with block length as expected
Cross-check decoding optimality by exhaustive small-block search or a second implementation
Inject burst errors or a mismatched prior and report degradation relative to the IID baseline

zh: 提交推导、编解码、基线、测试与绘图源文件
固定块长、码本生成规则、种子、停止准则与依赖
保存逐块原始结果、失败消息和自动生成报告
en: Commit derivation, codec, baseline, test, and plotting sources
Pin block lengths, codebook generation, seeds, stopping rules, and dependencies
Preserve per-block raw results, failed messages, and the generated report

safety_note.zh: 仅使用合成比特流；不得把未经独立验证的编码器用于紧急通信、医疗遥测或安全关键存储。
safety_note.en: Use synthetic bitstreams only; do not deploy the unvalidated codec to emergency communications, medical telemetry, or safety-critical storage.

summary.zh: MIT 的《Principles of Wireless Communications》以习题、项目和阅读材料补充无线通信专题；由于没有公开讲义或视频，不具备独立教学主线。
summary.en: MIT's Principles of Wireless Communications supplements wireless communications through problem sets, a project, and readings, but lacks public notes or videos for an independent teaching spine.

title.zh: 《Principles of Wireless Communications · MIT 6.452》端到端数字链路与同步压力测试
title.en: Principles of Wireless Communications · MIT 6.452: End-to-End Digital Link and Synchronization Stress Test

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Principles of Wireless Communications · MIT 6.452》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。为通信系统仿真发射、信道、同步、检测和误码统计的完整基带链路，量化 SNR、频偏、时偏和多径影响。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Principles of Wireless Communications · MIT 6.452, not an official course assignment. Simulate a complete baseband chain for Communication Systems, including transmit, channel, synchronization, detection, and error statistics, and quantify SNR, carrier offset, timing offset, and multipath effects.

zh: 调制、帧结构、信道、同步器和检测器的系统规格与链路预算
发送机、信道、接收机、基线检测器和测试源代码
每个 SNR 至少 100 个误码或 1e6 比特的原始计数、同步轨迹与星座
一份报告，比较理论/仿真 BER 并解释同步阈值和误差地板
en: A system specification and link budget for modulation, framing, channel, synchronizer, and detector
Transmitter, channel, receiver, baseline detector, and test sources
Raw counts, synchronization traces, and constellations with at least 100 errors or 1e6 bits per SNR
A report comparing theoretical and simulated BER and explaining synchronization thresholds and error floors

zh: AWGN 标称链路的 BER 置信区间覆盖理论曲线，或解释有限样本偏差
覆盖零信号、低 SNR、高 SNR、半符号时偏和指定频偏边界
用第二个独立调制解调实现交叉核对至少 1000 个无噪声符号
逐步增加频偏或多径，报告同步首次失锁点与 BER 退化
en: For the nominal AWGN link, make BER confidence intervals cover the theoretical curve or explain finite-sample bias
Cover zero signal, low and high SNR, half-symbol timing offset, and a declared carrier-offset boundary
Cross-check at least 1,000 noiseless symbols with an independent modem implementation
Increase carrier offset or multipath gradually and report the first synchronization-loss point and BER degradation

zh: 提交链路模块、配置、测试、理论计算和绘图源文件
固定采样率、帧长、种子、信道参数与依赖版本
保存逐帧原始计数/轨迹和由配置自动生成的报告
en: Commit link modules, configurations, tests, theory calculations, and plotting sources
Pin sample rate, frame length, seeds, channel parameters, and dependency versions
Preserve per-frame raw counts and traces and generate the report automatically from configuration

safety_note.zh: 仅做基带软件仿真；不得发射射频信号、绕过频谱法规或连接功率放大器与未知天线。
safety_note.en: Use baseband software simulation only; do not transmit RF, bypass spectrum rules, or connect power amplifiers or unknown antennas.

title.zh: 《Wireless Communications · Stanford University EE 359》端到端数字链路与同步压力测试
title.en: Wireless Communications · Stanford University EE 359: End-to-End Digital Link and Synchronization Stress Test

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Wireless Communications · Stanford University EE 359》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。为通信系统仿真发射、信道、同步、检测和误码统计的完整基带链路，量化 SNR、频偏、时偏和多径影响。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Wireless Communications · Stanford University EE 359, not an official course assignment. Simulate a complete baseband chain for Communication Systems, including transmit, channel, synchronization, detection, and error statistics, and quantify SNR, carrier offset, timing offset, and multipath effects.

zh: 调制、帧结构、信道、同步器和检测器的系统规格与链路预算
发送机、信道、接收机、基线检测器和测试源代码
每个 SNR 至少 100 个误码或 1e6 比特的原始计数、同步轨迹与星座
一份报告，比较理论/仿真 BER 并解释同步阈值和误差地板
en: A system specification and link budget for modulation, framing, channel, synchronizer, and detector
Transmitter, channel, receiver, baseline detector, and test sources
Raw counts, synchronization traces, and constellations with at least 100 errors or 1e6 bits per SNR
A report comparing theoretical and simulated BER and explaining synchronization thresholds and error floors

zh: AWGN 标称链路的 BER 置信区间覆盖理论曲线，或解释有限样本偏差
覆盖零信号、低 SNR、高 SNR、半符号时偏和指定频偏边界
用第二个独立调制解调实现交叉核对至少 1000 个无噪声符号
逐步增加频偏或多径，报告同步首次失锁点与 BER 退化
en: For the nominal AWGN link, make BER confidence intervals cover the theoretical curve or explain finite-sample bias
Cover zero signal, low and high SNR, half-symbol timing offset, and a declared carrier-offset boundary
Cross-check at least 1,000 noiseless symbols with an independent modem implementation
Increase carrier offset or multipath gradually and report the first synchronization-loss point and BER degradation

zh: 提交链路模块、配置、测试、理论计算和绘图源文件
固定采样率、帧长、种子、信道参数与依赖版本
保存逐帧原始计数/轨迹和由配置自动生成的报告
en: Commit link modules, configurations, tests, theory calculations, and plotting sources
Pin sample rate, frame length, seeds, channel parameters, and dependency versions
Preserve per-frame raw counts and traces and generate the report automatically from configuration

safety_note.zh: 仅做基带软件仿真；不得发射射频信号、绕过频谱法规或连接功率放大器与未知天线。
safety_note.en: Use baseband software simulation only; do not transmit RF, bypass spectrum rules, or connect power amplifiers or unknown antennas.

summary.zh: IIT Bombay / NPTEL 的《Principles of Digital Communications》以 65 个视频和周作业提供数字通信讲授序列；内容覆盖稳定，但认证考试收费且没有实验或代码闭环。
summary.en: IIT Bombay / NPTEL's Principles of Digital Communications provides a 65-lecture digital-communications sequence with weekly assignments, while certification is paid and no lab or code loop is available.

note.zh: 提供方公布 12 周；上方每周工时是维护者规划估计，依据课程角色与公开练习、实验密度生成，不是提供方承诺。先试学两周，若实际偏差超过 25%，据实调整。
note.en: The provider publishes 12 weeks; the weekly effort above is a maintainer planning estimate derived from course role and public practice/lab density, not a provider promise. Pilot two weeks and adjust when actual effort differs by more than 25%.

zh: 维护者建议的开源/免费验证路径：GNU Radio、Python 3、Jupyter、NumPy、SciPy 与 GNU Octave
资源清单未标注公开代码覆盖；上述工具仅用于维护者建议的独立验证，不代表提供方要求
en: Maintainer-suggested open-source/free verification path: GNU Radio, Python 3, Jupyter, NumPy, SciPy, and GNU Octave
The resource inventory does not list public code coverage; the tools above are only a maintainer-suggested independent check, not a provider requirement

zh: 资源清单未标注公开实验覆盖；默认只做仿真，不采购课程明确支持的软件定义无线电、衰减器、屏蔽连接与合规天线/负载。如自行扩展，先核对提供方范围并重新评估安全

zh: 建议先完成方向基础：信号与系统
建议先完成方向基础：概率、统计与随机过程
en: Recommended foundation: Signals and Systems
Recommended foundation: Probability, Statistics, and Random Processes

zh: 解释通信系统中的核心模型，并说明主要假设与适用边界
独立完成代表性推导与题目，并用量纲、极限情形或数值结果交叉检查

Theory dossier with explicit assumptions, notation, derivation, units, and boundary conditions, checked by at least one independent method
Simulation package with model or netlist, inputs, solver and version, parameter-sweep script, benchmark comparison, expected results, and one rerun command

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Electromagnetic Fields and Waves · Cornell University ECE 3030》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。围绕电磁场与波建立传输线或二维场边值问题，比较解析解与数值解，并审查网格、边界和材料参数导致的反射与能量误差。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Electromagnetic Fields and Waves · Cornell University ECE 3030, not an official course assignment. Formulate a transmission-line or two-dimensional boundary-value problem for Electromagnetic Fields and Waves, compare analytic and numerical solutions, and audit reflection and energy error from mesh, boundaries, and material parameters.

zh: 几何、材料、激励、边界条件、单位和解析基线说明
可执行传输线/有限差分/有限元模型及网格收敛配置
原始电场/磁场、S 参数或反射系数与能流数据
一份报告，比较解析与数值结果并解释边界反射、色散和网格失效
en: A specification of geometry, materials, excitation, boundary conditions, units, and analytic baseline
An executable transmission-line, finite-difference, or finite-element model with mesh-convergence configurations
Raw electric or magnetic fields, S-parameters or reflection coefficients, and energy-flow data
A report comparing analytic and numeric results and explaining boundary reflection, dispersion, and mesh failure

zh: 均匀线基线的特性阻抗或传播常数与解析值相差不超过 2%
在开路、短路、匹配和材料突变四种边界下检查反射系数极限
网格加密一倍后关键场量变化低于 3%，并记录收敛趋势
故意设置过近吸收边界或过粗网格，量化非物理反射和能量不平衡
en: Keep characteristic impedance or propagation constant within 2% of the analytic uniform-line baseline
Check reflection-coefficient limits for open, short, matched, and material-step boundaries
After doubling mesh resolution, keep the key field metric change below 3% and record convergence
Deliberately use an overly close absorbing boundary or coarse mesh and quantify spurious reflection and energy imbalance

zh: 提交几何/网格、求解器、后处理和解析计算源文件
固定求解器版本、材料参数、网格规则与收敛容差
保存原始场数据、求解日志和由脚本生成的报告
en: Commit geometry or mesh, solver, post-processing, and analytic-calculation sources
Pin solver version, material parameters, meshing rules, and convergence tolerances
Preserve raw field data, solver logs, and the script-generated report

safety_note.zh: 仅进行场与传输线仿真；不得搭建高压、强场、射频发射、微波加热或未知阻抗实体装置。
safety_note.en: Use field and transmission-line simulation only; do not build high-voltage, strong-field, RF-transmitting, microwave-heating, or unknown-impedance apparatus.

summary.zh: MIT 的《Electromagnetics and Applications》以开放教材、答案、演示和考试提供电磁学应用主线；文本与反馈资源优秀，但没有完整授课视频系列。
summary.en: MIT's Electromagnetics and Applications provides an applied electromagnetics spine through an open text, solutions, demonstrations, and exams, with excellent textual feedback but no full lecture-video series.

note.zh: 这是维护者规划估计，依据课程角色与公开练习、实验密度生成，不是提供方工时承诺。先试学两周，分别记录授课、练习、实验和复盘时间；若实际偏差超过 25%，据实调整剩余计划。

The resource inventory does not list public code coverage; the tools above are only a maintainer-suggested independent check, not a provider requirement

If the provider lists different equipment or compute requirements, follow its course page

zh: 建议先完成方向基础：工程数学
建议先完成方向基础：物理基础

Recommended foundation: Physics Foundations

zh: 解释电磁场与波中的核心模型，并说明主要假设与适用边界
独立完成代表性推导与题目，并用量纲、极限情形或数值结果交叉检查
en: Explain the core models in Electromagnetic Fields and Waves, including their assumptions and limits
Solve representative derivations and problems, checking units, limiting cases, or numerical results

zh: 按周学习日志：投入时间、问题、错误订正、决策、下一步，并链接本周可复现产物

在开路、短路、匹配和材料突变四种边界下检查反射系数极限
网格加密一倍后关键场量变化低于 3%，并记录收敛趋势
故意设置过近吸收边界或过粗网格，量化非物理反射和能量不平衡
en: Keep characteristic impedance or propagation constant within 2% of the analytic uniform-line baseline
Check reflection-coefficient limits for open, short, matched, and material-step boundaries
After doubling mesh resolution, keep the key field metric change below 3% and record convergence
Deliberately use an overly close absorbing boundary or coarse mesh and quantify spurious reflection and energy imbalance

zh: 提交几何/网格、求解器、后处理和解析计算源文件
固定求解器版本、材料参数、网格规则与收敛容差
保存原始场数据、求解日志和由脚本生成的报告
en: Commit geometry or mesh, solver, post-processing, and analytic-calculation sources
Pin solver version, material parameters, meshing rules, and convergence tolerances
Preserve raw field data, solver logs, and the script-generated report

safety_note.zh: 仅进行场与传输线仿真；不得搭建高压、强场、射频发射、微波加热或未知阻抗实体装置。
safety_note.en: Use field and transmission-line simulation only; do not build high-voltage, strong-field, RF-transmitting, microwave-heating, or unknown-impedance apparatus.

title.zh: 《Radio Frequency Systems · Cornell University ECE 4880》无源 RF 网络与天线匹配仿真
title.en: Radio Frequency Systems · Cornell University ECE 4880: Passive RF Network and Antenna-Matching Simulation

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Radio Frequency Systems · Cornell University ECE 4880》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。围绕射频、微波与天线设计一个无源匹配网络、传输线或天线模型，用 S 参数、稳定性/无源性和制造容差审查性能。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Radio Frequency Systems · Cornell University ECE 4880, not an official course assignment. Design a passive matching network, transmission line, or antenna model for RF, Microwave, and Antennas and audit S-parameters, passivity or stability, and manufacturing tolerance.

zh: 频段、端口阻抗、几何/材料、匹配和法规边界规格
电路或全波模型、网格/端口设置和参数扫描源文件
原始 S 参数、Smith 图数据、效率/增益或损耗及容差蒙特卡洛结果
一份报告，比较解析/电路/场解并解释谐振漂移和失配失败
en: A specification of band, port impedance, geometry or materials, matching, and regulatory boundary
Circuit or full-wave models, mesh and port settings, and parameter-sweep sources
Raw S-parameters, Smith-chart data, efficiency or gain or loss, and tolerance Monte Carlo results
A report comparing analytic, circuit, and field solutions and explaining resonance drift and mismatch failure

zh: 标称频段达到预先声明的回波损耗/插损目标，且无源性检查通过
覆盖 DC/低频极限、中心频率、频带边缘和材料参数极值
用传输线/匹配解析式交叉核对至少 5 个频点，关键量相差低于 5%
注入 ±10% 尺寸或介电常数偏差，报告谐振偏移和最坏失配
en: Meet the predeclared return-loss or insertion-loss target over the nominal band and pass a passivity check
Cover the DC or low-frequency limit, center frequency, band edges, and material-parameter extremes
Cross-check at least five frequency points against transmission-line or matching equations within 5%
Inject ±10% geometry or permittivity variation and report resonance shift and worst mismatch

zh: 提交几何、电路、网格、扫描和后处理源文件
固定求解器、材料模型、端口、网格规则和收敛容差
保存原始 Touchstone/场数据、求解日志和自动生成报告
en: Commit geometry, circuit, mesh, sweep, and post-processing sources
Pin solver, material models, ports, meshing rules, and convergence tolerances
Preserve raw Touchstone or field data, solver logs, and the generated report

safety_note.zh: 仅做无源 RF/天线仿真；不得发射、连接功率放大器、微波源或未知天线，也不得违反当地频谱法规。
safety_note.en: Use passive RF or antenna simulation only; do not transmit or connect power amplifiers, microwave sources, or unknown antennas, and do not violate local spectrum rules.

title.zh: 《RF and Millimeter-Wave Circuit Design · Eindhoven University of Technology RF and Millimeter-Wave Circuit Design》无源 RF 网络与天线匹配仿真
title.en: RF and Millimeter-Wave Circuit Design · Eindhoven University of Technology RF and Millimeter-Wave Circuit Design: Passive RF Network and Antenna-Matching Simulation

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《RF and Millimeter-Wave Circuit Design · Eindhoven University of Technology RF and Millimeter-Wave Circuit Design》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。围绕射频、微波与天线设计一个无源匹配网络、传输线或天线模型，用 S 参数、稳定性/无源性和制造容差审查性能。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for RF and Millimeter-Wave Circuit Design · Eindhoven University of Technology RF and Millimeter-Wave Circuit Design, not an official course assignment. Design a passive matching network, transmission line, or antenna model for RF, Microwave, and Antennas and audit S-parameters, passivity or stability, and manufacturing tolerance.

zh: 频段、端口阻抗、几何/材料、匹配和法规边界规格
电路或全波模型、网格/端口设置和参数扫描源文件
原始 S 参数、Smith 图数据、效率/增益或损耗及容差蒙特卡洛结果
一份报告，比较解析/电路/场解并解释谐振漂移和失配失败
en: A specification of band, port impedance, geometry or materials, matching, and regulatory boundary
Circuit or full-wave models, mesh and port settings, and parameter-sweep sources
Raw S-parameters, Smith-chart data, efficiency or gain or loss, and tolerance Monte Carlo results
A report comparing analytic, circuit, and field solutions and explaining resonance drift and mismatch failure

zh: 标称频段达到预先声明的回波损耗/插损目标，且无源性检查通过
覆盖 DC/低频极限、中心频率、频带边缘和材料参数极值
用传输线/匹配解析式交叉核对至少 5 个频点，关键量相差低于 5%
注入 ±10% 尺寸或介电常数偏差，报告谐振偏移和最坏失配
en: Meet the predeclared return-loss or insertion-loss target over the nominal band and pass a passivity check
Cover the DC or low-frequency limit, center frequency, band edges, and material-parameter extremes
Cross-check at least five frequency points against transmission-line or matching equations within 5%
Inject ±10% geometry or permittivity variation and report resonance shift and worst mismatch

zh: 提交几何、电路、网格、扫描和后处理源文件
固定求解器、材料模型、端口、网格规则和收敛容差
保存原始 Touchstone/场数据、求解日志和自动生成报告
en: Commit geometry, circuit, mesh, sweep, and post-processing sources
Pin solver, material models, ports, meshing rules, and convergence tolerances
Preserve raw Touchstone or field data, solver logs, and the generated report

safety_note.zh: 仅做无源 RF/天线仿真；不得发射、连接功率放大器、微波源或未知天线，也不得违反当地频谱法规。
safety_note.en: Use passive RF or antenna simulation only; do not transmit or connect power amplifiers, microwave sources, or unknown antennas, and do not violate local spectrum rules.

Theory dossier with explicit assumptions, notation, derivation, units, and boundary conditions, checked by at least one independent method

Design a passive matching network, transmission line, or antenna model for RF, Microwave, and Antennas and audit S-parameters, passivity or stability, and manufacturing tolerance.

zh: 频段、端口阻抗、几何/材料、匹配和法规边界规格
电路或全波模型、网格/端口设置和参数扫描源文件
原始 S 参数、Smith 图数据、效率/增益或损耗及容差蒙特卡洛结果
一份报告，比较解析/电路/场解并解释谐振漂移和失配失败
en: A specification of band, port impedance, geometry or materials, matching, and regulatory boundary
Circuit or full-wave models, mesh and port settings, and parameter-sweep sources
Raw S-parameters, Smith-chart data, efficiency or gain or loss, and tolerance Monte Carlo results
A report comparing analytic, circuit, and field solutions and explaining resonance drift and mismatch failure

zh: 标称频段达到预先声明的回波损耗/插损目标，且无源性检查通过
覆盖 DC/低频极限、中心频率、频带边缘和材料参数极值
用传输线/匹配解析式交叉核对至少 5 个频点，关键量相差低于 5%
注入 ±10% 尺寸或介电常数偏差，报告谐振偏移和最坏失配
en: Meet the predeclared return-loss or insertion-loss target over the nominal band and pass a passivity check
Cover the DC or low-frequency limit, center frequency, band edges, and material-parameter extremes
Cross-check at least five frequency points against transmission-line or matching equations within 5%
Inject ±10% geometry or permittivity variation and report resonance shift and worst mismatch

zh: 提交几何、电路、网格、扫描和后处理源文件
固定求解器、材料模型、端口、网格规则和收敛容差
保存原始 Touchstone/场数据、求解日志和自动生成报告
en: Commit geometry, circuit, mesh, sweep, and post-processing sources
Pin solver, material models, ports, meshing rules, and convergence tolerances
Preserve raw Touchstone or field data, solver logs, and the generated report

safety_note.zh: 仅做无源 RF/天线仿真；不得发射、连接功率放大器、微波源或未知天线，也不得违反当地频谱法规。
safety_note.en: Use passive RF or antenna simulation only; do not transmit or connect power amplifiers, microwave sources, or unknown antennas, and do not violate local spectrum rules.

summary.zh: MIT 的《Power Electronics》以当前视频、讲义、练习、设计任务和考试建立电力电子主线；理论与设计闭环异常完整，但实体硬件实验无法完全复现，独立学习默认只做仿真或限流低能量实验。
summary.en: MIT's Power Electronics builds a current power-electronics spine from videos, notes, practice, design work, and exams, with an unusually complete theory-and-design loop but no fully reproducible hardware lab; independent study should default to simulation or current-limited low-energy work.

note.zh: 这是维护者规划估计，依据课程角色与公开练习、实验密度生成，不是提供方工时承诺。先试学两周，分别记录授课、练习、实验和复盘时间；若实际偏差超过 25%，据实调整剩余计划。

zh: 资源清单包含实验覆盖；本课程的维护者路径明确将其限定为计算或仿真实验。只假设一台能运行上述软件并保存结果的通用计算机；不采购或连接合规实验室中的隔离/限流电源、差分探头、电子负载、示波器及课程指定功率级

It assumes only a general-purpose computer able to run the software above and retain results; do not purchase or connect isolated/current-limited power, differential probes, electronic load, oscilloscope, and course-specified power stage in a compliant lab

建议先完成方向基础：控制系统

title.zh: 《Power Electronics · MIT 6.622》变换器损耗与闭环保护仿真
title.en: Power Electronics · MIT 6.622: Converter Loss and Closed-Loop Protection Simulation

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Power Electronics · MIT 6.622》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。为电力电子仿真一个 DC–DC 变换器，量化纹波、效率代理、器件应力、控制稳定性和过流/开路保护。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Power Electronics · MIT 6.622, not an official course assignment. Simulate a DC–DC converter for Power Electronics and quantify ripple, efficiency proxy, device stress, control stability, and overcurrent or open-load protection.

zh: 拓扑、输入/输出范围、开关频率、器件额定值、控制和保护规格
开关模型、平均模型、控制器与故障场景源文件
稳态/启动/负载阶跃/故障的原始波形、损耗和应力数据
一份报告，比较解析/平均/开关模型并解释最坏应力与保护动作
en: A specification of topology, input and output range, switching frequency, ratings, control, and protection
Switching model, averaged model, controller, and fault-scenario sources
Raw steady-state, startup, load-step, and fault waveforms with loss and stress data
A report comparing analytic, averaged, and switching models and explaining worst stress and protection action

zh: 标称稳态输出误差低于 2%，纹波与手算相差不超过 15%
覆盖最小/最大输入、空载/满载、启动和器件参数极值
用功率平衡交叉核对输入/输出/损耗，归一化残差低于 1%
注入短路代理或负载突降，证明保护在预设时间内动作且所有额定值不过界
en: Keep nominal steady-state output error below 2% and ripple within 15% of hand analysis
Cover minimum and maximum input, no and full load, startup, and device-parameter extremes
Cross-check input, output, and loss by power balance with normalized residual below 1%
Inject a short-circuit proxy or load dump and show protection acts within the declared time without rating violations

zh: 提交拓扑、模型、控制器、故障、计算和绘图源文件
固定仿真器、器件模型、步长、开关与控制参数
保存原始波形、功率/应力表、故障日志和自动报告
en: Commit topology, models, controller, faults, calculations, and plotting sources
Pin simulator, device models, time step, switching, and control parameters
Preserve raw waveforms, power and stress tables, fault logs, and the generated report

safety_note.zh: 仅做变换器仿真；不得搭建市电、高压、大电流、磁性元件、电池供电或功率开关实体电路。
safety_note.en: Use converter simulation only; do not build mains, high-voltage, high-current, magnetic-component, battery-powered, or power-switching hardware.

title.zh: 《Power System Analysis · IIT Kharagpur / NPTEL 117105140》小型电网/电机运行边界研究
title.en: Power System Analysis · IIT Kharagpur / NPTEL 117105140: Small-Grid or Machine Operating-Boundary Study

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Power System Analysis · IIT Kharagpur / NPTEL 117105140》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。围绕电力系统与电机构建小型潮流、故障或电机 dq 模型，审查收敛、热/电流约束和扰动稳定性。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Power System Analysis · IIT Kharagpur / NPTEL 117105140, not an official course assignment. Build a compact load-flow, fault, or machine dq model for Power Systems and Electric Machines and audit convergence, thermal or current constraints, and disturbance stability.

zh: 单线图/电机参数、标幺基准、负荷/转矩范围和运行约束
潮流/故障/动态模型、场景生成与约束检查源文件
标称及至少 20 个扰动场景的原始电压、电流、功率/转矩和状态轨迹
一份报告，给出运行边界、最坏母线/绕组代理和不收敛案例
en: A one-line diagram or machine parameters, per-unit bases, load or torque range, and operating constraints
Load-flow, fault, or dynamic model, scenario generator, and constraint-check sources
Raw voltage, current, power or torque, and state trajectories for nominal and at least 20 disturbances
A report defining operating boundaries, worst bus or winding proxy, and a nonconvergent case

zh: 标称案例功率平衡残差低于 0.1%，且所有约束有明确裕量
覆盖空载、峰值负载、单元退出、故障代理和参数极值
用第二种潮流算法、解析短路值或能量平衡交叉核对关键结果
逐步增加负荷/转矩直至首次电压、热或稳定性失效并定位原因
en: Keep nominal power-balance residual below 0.1% with explicit margin on every constraint
Cover no load, peak load, one element out, a fault proxy, and parameter extremes
Cross-check key results with a second load-flow method, analytic short-circuit value, or energy balance
Increase load or torque until the first voltage, thermal, or stability failure and locate the cause

zh: 提交网络/电机数据、求解器、场景、检查和绘图源文件
固定标幺基准、求解器、容差、时间步长与数据版本
保存原始场景输入、状态轨迹、收敛日志和自动报告
en: Commit network or machine data, solver, scenarios, checks, and plotting sources
Pin per-unit bases, solver, tolerances, time step, and data version
Preserve raw scenario inputs, state trajectories, convergence logs, and the generated report

safety_note.zh: 仅做电网与电机仿真；不得连接市电、发电机、电机、高压源或任何大功率实体设备。
safety_note.en: Use grid and machine simulation only; do not connect mains, generators, motors, high-voltage sources, or any high-power physical equipment.

summary.zh: MIT 的《Seminar in Electric Power Systems》以带解答习题和项目示例补充电力系统学习；分析与项目资料有价值，但 2006 年电网和市场背景需要更新注释。
summary.en: MIT's Seminar in Electric Power Systems supplements power-systems study through solved problems and project examples, while its 2006 grid and market context needs explicit modernization notes.

note.zh: 这是维护者规划估计，依据课程角色与公开练习、实验密度生成，不是提供方工时承诺。先试学两周，分别记录授课、练习、实验和复盘时间；若实际偏差超过 25%，据实调整剩余计划。
note.en: This maintainer planning estimate is derived from course role and the density of public practice and labs; it is not a provider workload promise. Pilot two weeks while logging instruction, practice, lab, and review time, then adjust the remaining plan when actual effort differs by more than 25%.

zh: 维护者建议的开源/免费验证路径：pandapower、OpenDSS、Python 3、Jupyter 与 GNU Octave
资源清单包含公开代码覆盖；复现时固定解释器、依赖、工具链、数据集和 PDK（如适用）版本
en: Maintainer-suggested open-source/free verification path: pandapower, OpenDSS, Python 3, Jupyter, and GNU Octave
The resource inventory lists public code coverage; pin interpreter, dependencies, toolchain, datasets, and PDK versions where applicable

zh: 资源清单包含实验覆盖；本课程的维护者路径明确将其限定为计算或仿真实验。只假设一台能运行上述软件并保存结果的通用计算机；不采购或连接机构监督的三相/电机教学平台、隔离与保护装置、测量接口及紧急断电
en: The resource inventory lists lab coverage, but this course's maintainer path explicitly limits it to computational or simulation work. It assumes only a general-purpose computer able to run the software above and retain results; do not purchase or connect an institution-supervised three-phase/machine trainer, isolation and protection, measurement interface, and emergency shutdown

cost_note.zh: 当前维护者路径只使用计算与仿真，不设专用硬件采购；建议软件优先采用开源/免费工具。这不是提供方要求，平台访问、商业软件或云算力费用仍随提供方、地区与方案而变。
cost_note.en: The current maintainer path uses computation and simulation only, with no dedicated hardware purchase, and prefers open-source/free tools. This is not a provider requirement; platform, commercial-software, or cloud-compute costs still vary by provider, region, and plan.

note.zh: 默认实践范围仅限软件、计算或仿真；不得因资源清单中的“实验”标签自行连接实体设备，任何硬件扩展都必须重新核对提供方范围并进行风险评估。
note.en: The default practice scope is software, computation, or simulation only; a lab label in the resource inventory does not authorize connecting physical equipment, and any hardware extension requires provider-scope verification and a new risk assessment.

zh: 建议先完成方向基础：电路分析
建议先完成方向基础：电磁场与波
建议先完成方向基础：工程数学
en: Recommended foundation: Circuit Analysis
Recommended foundation: Electromagnetic Fields and Waves
Recommended foundation: Engineering Mathematics

zh: 解释电力系统与电机中的核心模型，并说明主要假设与适用边界
独立完成代表性推导与题目，并用量纲、极限情形或数值结果交叉检查
完成可复现实验或实现，保留原始数据、参数、版本和验证记录
en: Explain the core models in Power Systems and Electric Machines, including their assumptions and limits
Solve representative derivations and problems, checking units, limiting cases, or numerical results
Complete a reproducible experiment or implementation with raw data, parameters, versions, and verification

zh: 按周学习日志：投入时间、问题、错误订正、决策、下一步，并链接本周可复现产物

en: Weekly learning log with time, questions, corrected errors, decisions, next steps, and links to that week's reproducible artifacts
Theory dossier with explicit assumptions, notation, derivation, units, and boundary conditions, checked by at least one independent method
Simulation package with model or netlist, inputs, solver and version, parameter-sweep script, benchmark comparison, expected results, and one rerun command
Code repository with pinned dependencies and toolchain, a minimal run command, tests or waveform/benchmark checks, expected output, and license notes

title.zh: 《Electric Machines · MIT 6.685》小型电网/电机运行边界研究
title.en: Electric Machines · MIT 6.685: Small-Grid or Machine Operating-Boundary Study

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Electric Machines · MIT 6.685》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。围绕电力系统与电机构建小型潮流、故障或电机 dq 模型，审查收敛、热/电流约束和扰动稳定性。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Electric Machines · MIT 6.685, not an official course assignment. Build a compact load-flow, fault, or machine dq model for Power Systems and Electric Machines and audit convergence, thermal or current constraints, and disturbance stability.

zh: 单线图/电机参数、标幺基准、负荷/转矩范围和运行约束
潮流/故障/动态模型、场景生成与约束检查源文件
标称及至少 20 个扰动场景的原始电压、电流、功率/转矩和状态轨迹
一份报告，给出运行边界、最坏母线/绕组代理和不收敛案例
en: A one-line diagram or machine parameters, per-unit bases, load or torque range, and operating constraints
Load-flow, fault, or dynamic model, scenario generator, and constraint-check sources
Raw voltage, current, power or torque, and state trajectories for nominal and at least 20 disturbances
A report defining operating boundaries, worst bus or winding proxy, and a nonconvergent case

zh: 标称案例功率平衡残差低于 0.1%，且所有约束有明确裕量
覆盖空载、峰值负载、单元退出、故障代理和参数极值
用第二种潮流算法、解析短路值或能量平衡交叉核对关键结果
逐步增加负荷/转矩直至首次电压、热或稳定性失效并定位原因
en: Keep nominal power-balance residual below 0.1% with explicit margin on every constraint
Cover no load, peak load, one element out, a fault proxy, and parameter extremes
Cross-check key results with a second load-flow method, analytic short-circuit value, or energy balance
Increase load or torque until the first voltage, thermal, or stability failure and locate the cause

zh: 提交网络/电机数据、求解器、场景、检查和绘图源文件
固定标幺基准、求解器、容差、时间步长与数据版本
保存原始场景输入、状态轨迹、收敛日志和自动报告
en: Commit network or machine data, solver, scenarios, checks, and plotting sources
Pin per-unit bases, solver, tolerances, time step, and data version
Preserve raw scenario inputs, state trajectories, convergence logs, and the generated report

safety_note.zh: 仅做电网与电机仿真；不得连接市电、发电机、电机、高压源或任何大功率实体设备。
safety_note.en: Use grid and machine simulation only; do not connect mains, generators, motors, high-voltage sources, or any high-power physical equipment.

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Solar Energy Engineering: Photovoltaic Energy Conversion · Delft University of Technology PV Energy Conversion》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。为储能与光伏用公开/合成数据建立电池或光伏数字孪生，评估状态估计、能量调度、温度/辐照变化和安全约束。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Solar Energy Engineering: Photovoltaic Energy Conversion · Delft University of Technology PV Energy Conversion, not an official course assignment. Build a battery or PV digital twin from public or synthetic data for Energy Storage and Photovoltaics and evaluate state estimation, energy scheduling, temperature or irradiance changes, and safety constraints.

zh: 等效模型、状态/参数、功率与温度边界、调度目标和数据来源

Model calibration, state estimation, scheduling, constraint checking, and scenario-simulation sources
Raw public or synthetic curves, fit residuals, state-of-charge or power trajectories, and constraint logs
A report comparing baseline and improved strategies and analyzing aging, shading, or thermal-drift failure

zh: 保留数据上的电压/功率归一化 RMSE 低于 5%，或据数据噪声声明阈值

Inject capacity fade or partial shading and show that constraint checks prevent an out-of-bounds schedule

title.en: Electrochemical Energy Systems · MIT 10.626: Battery or PV Energy-Management Digital Twin

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Electrochemical Energy Systems · MIT 10.626》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。为储能与光伏用公开/合成数据建立电池或光伏数字孪生，评估状态估计、能量调度、温度/辐照变化和安全约束。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Electrochemical Energy Systems · MIT 10.626, not an official course assignment. Build a battery or PV digital twin from public or synthetic data for Energy Storage and Photovoltaics and evaluate state estimation, energy scheduling, temperature or irradiance changes, and safety constraints.

zh: 等效模型、状态/参数、功率与温度边界、调度目标和数据来源
模型校准、状态估计、调度、约束检查与场景仿真源文件
原始公开/合成曲线、拟合残差、SOC/功率轨迹和约束日志
一份报告，比较基线/改进策略并分析老化、遮挡或温漂失效
en: Equivalent model, states and parameters, power and temperature bounds, scheduling objective, and data provenance
Model calibration, state estimation, scheduling, constraint checking, and scenario-simulation sources
Raw public or synthetic curves, fit residuals, state-of-charge or power trajectories, and constraint logs
A report comparing baseline and improved strategies and analyzing aging, shading, or thermal-drift failure

zh: 保留数据上的电压/功率归一化 RMSE 低于 5%，或据数据噪声声明阈值
覆盖空/满状态边界、温度极值、功率突变和传感偏置
用能量积分交叉核对 SOC 或累计发电量，归一化残差低于 2%
注入容量衰减或局部遮挡，证明约束检查阻止越界调度
en: Keep normalized voltage or power RMSE below 5% on held-out data or declare a noise-based threshold
Cover empty and full state boundaries, temperature extremes, power steps, and sensor bias
Cross-check state of charge or cumulative generation by energy integration with normalized residual below 2%
Inject capacity fade or partial shading and show that constraint checks prevent an out-of-bounds schedule

zh: 提交模型、校准、估计、调度、场景和绘图源文件
固定数据版本、单位、求解器、参数、随机种子和环境
保存原始公开/合成数据、来源/许可、校验和与自动报告
en: Commit model, calibration, estimation, scheduling, scenario, and plotting sources
Pin data version, units, solver, parameters, random seeds, and environment
Preserve raw public or synthetic data, provenance and license, checksums, and the generated report

safety_note.zh: 仅使用公开/合成数据和仿真；不得充放真实电池、拆解电芯、连接光伏阵列、市电、高压或激光光源。
safety_note.en: Use public or synthetic data and simulation only; do not charge, discharge, or open real cells or connect PV arrays, mains, high voltage, or laser sources.

summary.zh: Cornell University 的《Physics of Semiconductors and Nanostructures》以 32 份讲义、11 套带解答作业和大部分带解答考试建立半导体物理文本主线；没有视频但反馈充分。

Pilot two weeks while logging instruction, practice, lab, and review time, then adjust the remaining plan when actual effort differs by more than 25%.

title.zh: 《Physics of Semiconductors and Nanostructures · Cornell University ECE 4070》半导体器件 I–V/C–V 模型校准
title.en: Physics of Semiconductors and Nanostructures · Cornell University ECE 4070: Semiconductor Device I–V/C–V Model Calibration

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Physics of Semiconductors and Nanostructures · Cornell University ECE 4070》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。为半导体器件建立二极管、MOS 或结器件的解析与数值模型，用公开/合成 I–V 或 C–V 数据提取参数并审查温度和高场边界。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Physics of Semiconductors and Nanostructures · Cornell University ECE 4070, not an official course assignment. Build analytic and numerical diode, MOS, or junction-device models for Semiconductor Devices, fit parameters to public or synthetic I–V or C–V data, and audit temperature and high-field limits.

zh: 器件结构、方程、单位、参数范围和适用假设说明
数据生成/导入、参数拟合、预测和残差分析源文件
原始 I–V/C–V 数据、训练/验证划分、拟合参数和置信区间
一份报告，比较解析/数值/数据并解释亚阈值、高注入或击穿附近失效
en: A specification of device structure, equations, units, parameter ranges, and validity assumptions
Source files for data generation or import, parameter fitting, prediction, and residual analysis

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Micro and Nanofabrication (MEMS) · EPFL memsX》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。为微纳工艺与 MEMS提出一个虚拟 MEMS/微纳结构与工艺流程，在仿真中验证几何、残余应力、刻蚀偏差和失效裕量。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Micro and Nanofabrication (MEMS) · EPFL memsX, not an official course assignment. Propose a virtual MEMS or microfabricated structure and process flow for Micro/Nanofabrication and MEMS, then simulate geometry, residual stress, etch bias, and failure margin.

zh: 器件截面、掩膜层、材料、工艺顺序、设计规则和风险分析
参数化几何/有限元模型与工艺容差扫描源文件
原始位移/频率/应力/热或流体结果及至少 100 个容差样本
一份报告，给出工艺窗口、良率代理、失效模式和版图修正
en: Device cross section, mask layers, materials, process sequence, design rules, and risk analysis
Parameterized geometry or finite-element model and process-tolerance sweep sources
Raw displacement, frequency, stress, thermal or fluid results and at least 100 tolerance samples
A report defining process window, yield proxy, failure modes, and layout correction

zh: 标称结构与简化梁/膜解析模型的关键响应相差不超过 10%
覆盖最小线宽、最大刻蚀偏差、材料极值和机械接触/屈曲边界
网格加密后关键指标变化低于 5%，并报告能量/力平衡
注入残余应力或掩膜偏移，定位首次设计规则或性能失效
en: Keep the nominal key response within 10% of a simplified beam or membrane analytic model
Cover minimum feature, maximum etch bias, material extremes, and contact or buckling boundaries
After mesh refinement, keep the key metric change below 5% and report energy or force balance
Inject residual stress or mask misalignment and locate the first design-rule or performance failure

zh: 提交截面/掩膜、参数化几何、求解、扫描和后处理源文件
固定求解器、材料库、网格规则、工艺参数与容差种子
保存原始场/几何数据、求解日志和自动生成报告
en: Commit cross-section or mask, parametric geometry, solver, sweep, and post-processing sources
Pin solver, material library, meshing rules, process parameters, and tolerance seeds
Preserve raw field and geometry data, solver logs, and the generated report

safety_note.zh: 仅做工艺规划与仿真；不使用化学品、真空、等离子体、光刻、洁净室设备或真实微机械结构。
safety_note.en: Use process planning and simulation only; do not use chemicals, vacuum, plasma, lithography, cleanroom equipment, or physical micromechanical structures.

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Design and Fabrication of Microelectromechanical Devices · MIT 6.777J》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。为微纳工艺与 MEMS提出一个虚拟 MEMS/微纳结构与工艺流程，在仿真中验证几何、残余应力、刻蚀偏差和失效裕量。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Design and Fabrication of Microelectromechanical Devices · MIT 6.777J, not an official course assignment. Propose a virtual MEMS or microfabricated structure and process flow for Micro/Nanofabrication and MEMS, then simulate geometry, residual stress, etch bias, and failure margin.

zh: 器件截面、掩膜层、材料、工艺顺序、设计规则和风险分析
参数化几何/有限元模型与工艺容差扫描源文件
原始位移/频率/应力/热或流体结果及至少 100 个容差样本
一份报告，给出工艺窗口、良率代理、失效模式和版图修正
en: Device cross section, mask layers, materials, process sequence, design rules, and risk analysis
Parameterized geometry or finite-element model and process-tolerance sweep sources
Raw displacement, frequency, stress, thermal or fluid results and at least 100 tolerance samples
A report defining process window, yield proxy, failure modes, and layout correction

zh: 标称结构与简化梁/膜解析模型的关键响应相差不超过 10%
覆盖最小线宽、最大刻蚀偏差、材料极值和机械接触/屈曲边界
网格加密后关键指标变化低于 5%，并报告能量/力平衡
注入残余应力或掩膜偏移，定位首次设计规则或性能失效
en: Keep the nominal key response within 10% of a simplified beam or membrane analytic model
Cover minimum feature, maximum etch bias, material extremes, and contact or buckling boundaries
After mesh refinement, keep the key metric change below 5% and report energy or force balance
Inject residual stress or mask misalignment and locate the first design-rule or performance failure

zh: 提交截面/掩膜、参数化几何、求解、扫描和后处理源文件
固定求解器、材料库、网格规则、工艺参数与容差种子
保存原始场/几何数据、求解日志和自动生成报告
en: Commit cross-section or mask, parametric geometry, solver, sweep, and post-processing sources
Pin solver, material library, meshing rules, process parameters, and tolerance seeds
Preserve raw field and geometry data, solver logs, and the generated report

safety_note.zh: 仅做工艺规划与仿真；不使用化学品、真空、等离子体、光刻、洁净室设备或真实微机械结构。
safety_note.en: Use process planning and simulation only; do not use chemicals, vacuum, plasma, lithography, cleanroom equipment, or physical micromechanical structures.

summary.zh: Cornell University 的《Quantum Optics for Photonics》以讲义、十套带解答作业和部分带解答考试提供研究生量子光学路径；没有视频，期末考试也无答案。
summary.en: Cornell University's Quantum Optics for Photonics provides a graduate quantum-optics path through notes, ten solved homework sets, and partly solved exams, while lacking video and a final-exam solution.

note.zh: 这是维护者规划估计，依据课程角色与公开练习、实验密度生成，不是提供方工时承诺。先试学两周，分别记录授课、练习、实验和复盘时间；若实际偏差超过 25%，据实调整剩余计划。

Pilot two weeks while logging instruction, practice, lab, and review time, then adjust the remaining plan when actual effort differs by more than 25%.

title.zh: 《Quantum Optics for Photonics · Cornell University ECE 5310》光波导/成像系统参数扫描
title.en: Quantum Optics for Photonics · Cornell University ECE 5310: Waveguide or Imaging-System Parameter Sweep

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Quantum Optics for Photonics · Cornell University ECE 5310》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。围绕光学、光电与光子学构建波导、谐振器或成像系统仿真，用解析极限、网格收敛和制造容差验证模式、损耗或成像质量。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Quantum Optics for Photonics · Cornell University ECE 5310, not an official course assignment. Simulate a waveguide, resonator, or imaging system for Optics, Optoelectronics, and Photonics and validate mode, loss, or image quality using analytic limits, mesh convergence, and manufacturing tolerances.

zh: 波长、材料、几何、偏振、边界和目标指标规格
可执行光学/电磁模型、参数扫描与后处理源文件
原始场、模式/点扩散函数、透射/损耗和容差数据
一份报告，比较解析/数值结果并解释截止、色散或像差失败
en: A specification of wavelength, materials, geometry, polarization, boundaries, and target metrics
Executable optical or electromagnetic model, parameter sweeps, and post-processing sources
Raw fields, modes or point-spread functions, transmission or loss, and tolerance data
A report comparing analytic and numeric results and explaining cutoff, dispersion, or aberration failure

zh: 简单基线的有效折射率、焦距或衍射尺度与解析值相差不超过 3%
覆盖截止附近、频带边缘、材料极值和偏振切换边界
网格加密或第二种传播算法后关键指标变化低于 3%
注入 ±5% 几何偏差，报告模式丢失、谐振漂移或成像退化
en: Keep effective index, focal length, or diffraction scale within 3% of an analytic simple baseline
Cover near-cutoff, band-edge, material-extreme, and polarization-switch boundaries
Keep the key metric change below 3% after mesh refinement or a second propagation method
Inject ±5% geometry variation and report mode loss, resonance shift, or image degradation

zh: 提交几何、材料、求解、扫描和绘图源文件
固定求解器、波长网格、材料数据版本和收敛参数
保存原始场/图像、求解日志、材料来源与自动报告
en: Commit geometry, material, solver, sweep, and plotting sources
Pin solver, wavelength grid, material-data version, and convergence parameters
Preserve raw fields or images, solver logs, material provenance, and the generated report

safety_note.zh: 仅做光学/光子仿真；不得使用激光器、强光源、高压驱动、光纤裸端或未经监督的光学实验。
safety_note.en: Use optical or photonic simulation only; do not use lasers, intense sources, high-voltage drivers, bare fiber ends, or unsupervised optical experiments.

summary.zh: Cornell University 的《Semiconductor Optoelectronics》以 16 份讲义和八套带解答作业建立半导体光电子主线；文本反馈优秀，但无视频或实验且先修要求严格。

title.zh: 《Semiconductor Optoelectronics · Cornell University ECE 5330》光波导/成像系统参数扫描
title.en: Semiconductor Optoelectronics · Cornell University ECE 5330: Waveguide or Imaging-System Parameter Sweep

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Semiconductor Optoelectronics · Cornell University ECE 5330》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。围绕光学、光电与光子学构建波导、谐振器或成像系统仿真，用解析极限、网格收敛和制造容差验证模式、损耗或成像质量。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Semiconductor Optoelectronics · Cornell University ECE 5330, not an official course assignment. Simulate a waveguide, resonator, or imaging system for Optics, Optoelectronics, and Photonics and validate mode, loss, or image quality using analytic limits, mesh convergence, and manufacturing tolerances.

zh: 波长、材料、几何、偏振、边界和目标指标规格
可执行光学/电磁模型、参数扫描与后处理源文件
原始场、模式/点扩散函数、透射/损耗和容差数据
一份报告，比较解析/数值结果并解释截止、色散或像差失败
en: A specification of wavelength, materials, geometry, polarization, boundaries, and target metrics
Executable optical or electromagnetic model, parameter sweeps, and post-processing sources
Raw fields, modes or point-spread functions, transmission or loss, and tolerance data
A report comparing analytic and numeric results and explaining cutoff, dispersion, or aberration failure

zh: 简单基线的有效折射率、焦距或衍射尺度与解析值相差不超过 3%
覆盖截止附近、频带边缘、材料极值和偏振切换边界
网格加密或第二种传播算法后关键指标变化低于 3%
注入 ±5% 几何偏差，报告模式丢失、谐振漂移或成像退化
en: Keep effective index, focal length, or diffraction scale within 3% of an analytic simple baseline
Cover near-cutoff, band-edge, material-extreme, and polarization-switch boundaries
Keep the key metric change below 3% after mesh refinement or a second propagation method
Inject ±5% geometry variation and report mode loss, resonance shift, or image degradation

zh: 提交几何、材料、求解、扫描和绘图源文件
固定求解器、波长网格、材料数据版本和收敛参数
保存原始场/图像、求解日志、材料来源与自动报告
en: Commit geometry, material, solver, sweep, and plotting sources
Pin solver, wavelength grid, material-data version, and convergence parameters
Preserve raw fields or images, solver logs, material provenance, and the generated report

safety_note.zh: 仅做光学/光子仿真；不得使用激光器、强光源、高压驱动、光纤裸端或未经监督的光学实验。
safety_note.en: Use optical or photonic simulation only; do not use lasers, intense sources, high-voltage drivers, bare fiber ends, or unsupervised optical experiments.

summary.zh: IIT Madras / NPTEL 的《Introduction to Photonics》公开 34 个主题讲次、4 个 tutorial 和 10 个实验演示，能形成宽口径光子学主线；匿名公开 API 没有作业、答案或评分入口。
summary.en: IIT Madras / NPTEL's Introduction to Photonics provides thirty-four topic lectures, four tutorials, and ten laboratory demonstrations for a broad photonics spine, but the anonymous public API exposes no assignments, answers, or grading endpoint.

note.zh: 这是维护者规划估计，依据课程角色与公开练习、实验密度生成，不是提供方工时承诺。先试学两周，分别记录授课、练习、实验和复盘时间；若实际偏差超过 25%，据实调整剩余计划。
note.en: This maintainer planning estimate is derived from course role and the density of public practice and labs; it is not a provider workload promise. Pilot two weeks while logging instruction, practice, lab, and review time, then adjust the remaining plan when actual effort differs by more than 25%.

zh: 维护者建议的开源/免费验证路径：MEEP、MPB、Python 3、Jupyter 与 ParaView
资源清单未标注公开代码覆盖；上述工具仅用于维护者建议的独立验证，不代表提供方要求
en: Maintainer-suggested open-source/free verification path: MEEP, MPB, Python 3, Jupyter, and ParaView
The resource inventory does not list public code coverage; the tools above are only a maintainer-suggested independent check, not a provider requirement

zh: 资源清单包含实验覆盖；本课程的维护者路径明确将其限定为计算或仿真实验。只假设一台能运行上述软件并保存结果的通用计算机；不采购或连接合规光学实验室中的课程指定光源、光学件、探测器、遮光与激光安全防护
en: The resource inventory lists lab coverage, but this course's maintainer path explicitly limits it to computational or simulation work. It assumes only a general-purpose computer able to run the software above and retain results; do not purchase or connect course-specified sources, optics, detectors, beam containment, and laser safety controls in a compliant optics lab

cost_note.zh: 当前维护者路径只使用计算与仿真，不设专用硬件采购；建议软件优先采用开源/免费工具。这不是提供方要求，平台访问、商业软件或云算力费用仍随提供方、地区与方案而变。
cost_note.en: The current maintainer path uses computation and simulation only, with no dedicated hardware purchase, and prefers open-source/free tools. This is not a provider requirement; platform, commercial-software, or cloud-compute costs still vary by provider, region, and plan.

note.zh: 默认实践范围仅限软件、计算或仿真；不得因资源清单中的“实验”标签自行连接实体设备，任何硬件扩展都必须重新核对提供方范围并进行风险评估。
note.en: The default practice scope is software, computation, or simulation only; a lab label in the resource inventory does not authorize connecting physical equipment, and any hardware extension requires provider-scope verification and a new risk assessment.

zh: 建议先完成方向基础：电磁场与波
建议先完成方向基础：半导体器件
建议先完成方向基础：物理基础
en: Recommended foundation: Electromagnetic Fields and Waves
Recommended foundation: Semiconductor Devices
Recommended foundation: Physics Foundations

zh: 解释光学、光电与光子学中的核心模型，并说明主要假设与适用边界
完成可复现实验或实现，保留原始数据、参数、版本和验证记录
en: Explain the core models in Optics, Optoelectronics, and Photonics, including their assumptions and limits
Complete a reproducible experiment or implementation with raw data, parameters, versions, and verification

zh: 按周学习日志：投入时间、问题、错误订正、决策、下一步，并链接本周可复现产物
理论推导档案：逐项列出假设、符号、推导、单位与边界条件，并用至少一种独立方法复核
仿真包：模型或网表、输入、求解器与版本、参数扫描脚本、基准对照、预期结果及一条重新运行命令
en: Weekly learning log with time, questions, corrected errors, decisions, next steps, and links to that week's reproducible artifacts
Theory dossier with explicit assumptions, notation, derivation, units, and boundary conditions, checked by at least one independent method
Simulation package with model or netlist, inputs, solver and version, parameter-sweep script, benchmark comparison, expected results, and one rerun command

selection_note.zh: 主线课程，核心内容可靠，适合按自身背景作为主课或高质量替代。
selection_note.en: Mainline course. A reliable option that can serve as a main course or strong alternative.

review_note.zh: 实验条目是演示而非家庭光学实验；公开层未核验到作业与答案，独立学习者需要另建反馈链。
review_note.en: The laboratory items are demonstrations rather than home optics labs; no public assignments or answers were verified, so independent learners need a separate feedback loop.

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Silicon Photonics Design, Fabrication and Data Analysis · University of British Columbia Phot1x》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。围绕光学、光电与光子学构建波导、谐振器或成像系统仿真，用解析极限、网格收敛和制造容差验证模式、损耗或成像质量。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Silicon Photonics Design, Fabrication and Data Analysis · University of British Columbia Phot1x, not an official course assignment. Simulate a waveguide, resonator, or imaging system for Optics, Optoelectronics, and Photonics and validate mode, loss, or image quality using analytic limits, mesh convergence, and manufacturing tolerances.

zh: 波长、材料、几何、偏振、边界和目标指标规格
可执行光学/电磁模型、参数扫描与后处理源文件
原始场、模式/点扩散函数、透射/损耗和容差数据
一份报告，比较解析/数值结果并解释截止、色散或像差失败
en: A specification of wavelength, materials, geometry, polarization, boundaries, and target metrics
Executable optical or electromagnetic model, parameter sweeps, and post-processing sources
Raw fields, modes or point-spread functions, transmission or loss, and tolerance data
A report comparing analytic and numeric results and explaining cutoff, dispersion, or aberration failure

zh: 简单基线的有效折射率、焦距或衍射尺度与解析值相差不超过 3%
覆盖截止附近、频带边缘、材料极值和偏振切换边界
网格加密或第二种传播算法后关键指标变化低于 3%
注入 ±5% 几何偏差，报告模式丢失、谐振漂移或成像退化
en: Keep effective index, focal length, or diffraction scale within 3% of an analytic simple baseline
Cover near-cutoff, band-edge, material-extreme, and polarization-switch boundaries
Keep the key metric change below 3% after mesh refinement or a second propagation method
Inject ±5% geometry variation and report mode loss, resonance shift, or image degradation

zh: 提交几何、材料、求解、扫描和绘图源文件
固定求解器、波长网格、材料数据版本和收敛参数
保存原始场/图像、求解日志、材料来源与自动报告
en: Commit geometry, material, solver, sweep, and plotting sources
Pin solver, wavelength grid, material-data version, and convergence parameters
Preserve raw fields or images, solver logs, material provenance, and the generated report

safety_note.zh: 仅做光学/光子仿真；不得使用激光器、强光源、高压驱动、光纤裸端或未经监督的光学实验。
safety_note.en: Use optical or photonic simulation only; do not use lasers, intense sources, high-voltage drivers, bare fiber ends, or unsupervised optical experiments.

summary.zh: MIT 的《Optics》以 10 组讲义、6 份习题和多套 quiz/期末考试提供严格光学理论主线；习题 1–4 有解而 5–6 无解，考试反馈较强，但没有完整视频或公开可复现实验。
summary.en: MIT's Optics provides a rigorous theory spine through ten groups of notes, six problem sets, and multiple quiz and final sets; problem sets 1–4 are solved while 5–6 are not, assessment feedback is strong, and no full video series or public reproducible lab is available.

note.zh: 这是维护者规划估计，依据课程角色与公开练习、实验密度生成，不是提供方工时承诺。先试学两周，分别记录授课、练习、实验和复盘时间；若实际偏差超过 25%，据实调整剩余计划。
note.en: This maintainer planning estimate is derived from course role and the density of public practice and labs; it is not a provider workload promise. Pilot two weeks while logging instruction, practice, lab, and review time, then adjust the remaining plan when actual effort differs by more than 25%.

zh: 维护者建议的开源/免费验证路径：MEEP、MPB、Python 3、Jupyter 与 ParaView
资源清单未标注公开代码覆盖；上述工具仅用于维护者建议的独立验证，不代表提供方要求
en: Maintainer-suggested open-source/free verification path: MEEP, MPB, Python 3, Jupyter, and ParaView
The resource inventory does not list public code coverage; the tools above are only a maintainer-suggested independent check, not a provider requirement

zh: 资源清单未标注公开实验覆盖；默认只做仿真，不采购合规光学实验室中的课程指定光源、光学件、探测器、遮光与激光安全防护。如自行扩展，先核对提供方范围并重新评估安全
en: The resource inventory does not list public lab coverage; default to simulation and do not purchase course-specified sources, optics, detectors, beam containment, and laser safety controls in a compliant optics lab. If extending the course independently, first verify provider scope and reassess safety

cost_note.zh: 当前维护者路径不设专用硬件采购，建议软件优先采用开源/免费工具；这不是提供方要求。若提供方另列商业软件、元件、设备或机构访问，费用随提供方、地区和机构而变。
cost_note.en: The current maintainer path assumes no dedicated hardware purchase and prefers open-source/free software; this is not a provider requirement. If the provider separately lists commercial software, components, equipment, or institutional access, costs vary by provider, region, and institution.

note.zh: 课程记录未要求实体实验；遵守一般用电、人体工学、数据和设备使用规范。
note.en: No physical lab is recorded; follow ordinary electrical, ergonomic, data, and equipment-use precautions.

zh: 建议先完成方向基础：电磁场与波
建议先完成方向基础：半导体器件
建议先完成方向基础：物理基础
en: Recommended foundation: Electromagnetic Fields and Waves
Recommended foundation: Semiconductor Devices
Recommended foundation: Physics Foundations

zh: 解释光学、光电与光子学中的核心模型，并说明主要假设与适用边界
独立完成代表性推导与题目，并用量纲、极限情形或数值结果交叉检查
en: Explain the core models in Optics, Optoelectronics, and Photonics, including their assumptions and limits
Solve representative derivations and problems, checking units, limiting cases, or numerical results

zh: 按周学习日志：投入时间、问题、错误订正、决策、下一步，并链接本周可复现产物
理论推导档案：逐项列出假设、符号、推导、单位与边界条件，并用至少一种独立方法复核
仿真包：模型或网表、输入、求解器与版本、参数扫描脚本、基准对照、预期结果及一条重新运行命令
en: Weekly learning log with time, questions, corrected errors, decisions, next steps, and links to that week's reproducible artifacts
Theory dossier with explicit assumptions, notation, derivation, units, and boundary conditions, checked by at least one independent method
Simulation package with model or netlist, inputs, solver and version, parameter-sweep script, benchmark comparison, expected results, and one rerun command

selection_note.zh: 主线课程，资源完整、教学设计清晰，适合作为该方向的优先选择。（审阅记录：S/A）
selection_note.en: Mainline course. A particularly complete and well-structured option for this track. Review note: S/A

review_note.zh: 理论与考核闭环较强：习题 1–4 有解、5–6 无解，多套 quiz 与期末考试带解答；但没有完整授课视频系列或公开可复现的实体实验。
review_note.en: The theory and assessment loop is strong: problem sets 1–4 have solutions, while 5–6 do not, and multiple quiz and final sets include solutions. There is no full lecture-video series or public reproducible physical laboratory.

title.zh: 《Photonic Materials and Devices · MIT 3.46》光波导/成像系统参数扫描
title.en: Photonic Materials and Devices · MIT 3.46: Waveguide or Imaging-System Parameter Sweep

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Photonic Materials and Devices · MIT 3.46》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。围绕光学、光电与光子学构建波导、谐振器或成像系统仿真，用解析极限、网格收敛和制造容差验证模式、损耗或成像质量。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Photonic Materials and Devices · MIT 3.46, not an official course assignment. Simulate a waveguide, resonator, or imaging system for Optics, Optoelectronics, and Photonics and validate mode, loss, or image quality using analytic limits, mesh convergence, and manufacturing tolerances.

zh: 波长、材料、几何、偏振、边界和目标指标规格
可执行光学/电磁模型、参数扫描与后处理源文件
原始场、模式/点扩散函数、透射/损耗和容差数据
一份报告，比较解析/数值结果并解释截止、色散或像差失败
en: A specification of wavelength, materials, geometry, polarization, boundaries, and target metrics
Executable optical or electromagnetic model, parameter sweeps, and post-processing sources
Raw fields, modes or point-spread functions, transmission or loss, and tolerance data
A report comparing analytic and numeric results and explaining cutoff, dispersion, or aberration failure

zh: 简单基线的有效折射率、焦距或衍射尺度与解析值相差不超过 3%
覆盖截止附近、频带边缘、材料极值和偏振切换边界
网格加密或第二种传播算法后关键指标变化低于 3%
注入 ±5% 几何偏差，报告模式丢失、谐振漂移或成像退化
en: Keep effective index, focal length, or diffraction scale within 3% of an analytic simple baseline
Cover near-cutoff, band-edge, material-extreme, and polarization-switch boundaries
Keep the key metric change below 3% after mesh refinement or a second propagation method
Inject ±5% geometry variation and report mode loss, resonance shift, or image degradation

zh: 提交几何、材料、求解、扫描和绘图源文件
固定求解器、波长网格、材料数据版本和收敛参数
保存原始场/图像、求解日志、材料来源与自动报告
en: Commit geometry, material, solver, sweep, and plotting sources
Pin solver, wavelength grid, material-data version, and convergence parameters
Preserve raw fields or images, solver logs, material provenance, and the generated report

safety_note.zh: 仅做光学/光子仿真；不得使用激光器、强光源、高压驱动、光纤裸端或未经监督的光学实验。
safety_note.en: Use optical or photonic simulation only; do not use lasers, intense sources, high-voltage drivers, bare fiber ends, or unsupervised optical experiments.

note.zh: 仅开展隔离、限流、低能量实验；通电前检查额定值、接地、短路风险和紧急断电方式。
note.en: Keep work isolated, current-limited, and low energy; verify ratings, grounding, short-circuit risk, and emergency shutdown before power-up.

title.zh: 《Electrical Measurement and Electronic Instruments · IIT Kharagpur / NPTEL 108105153》传感器校准、漂移与不确定度验证
title.en: Electrical Measurement and Electronic Instruments · IIT Kharagpur / NPTEL 108105153: Sensor Calibration, Drift, and Uncertainty Validation

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Electrical Measurement and Electronic Instruments · IIT Kharagpur / NPTEL 108105153》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。为传感器与仪器使用低压传感器或合成数据建立校准曲线、漂移模型和不确定度预算，并验证断线、饱和和交叉敏感。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Electrical Measurement and Electronic Instruments · IIT Kharagpur / NPTEL 108105153, not an official course assignment. Use a low-voltage sensor or synthetic data for Sensors and Instrumentation to build calibration and drift models with an uncertainty budget and test disconnect, saturation, and cross-sensitivity.

zh: 量程、分辨率、采样、参考量、环境和不确定度目标规格
采集/生成、校准拟合、漂移补偿和故障检测源文件
至少 5 个校准点各 10 次重复的原始数据、时间/环境记录
一份报告，给出残差、不确定度、漂移和交叉敏感/断线失败
en: A specification for range, resolution, acquisition, reference, environment, and uncertainty target
Acquisition or generation, calibration fit, drift compensation, and fault-detection sources
Raw data, time, and environment records for at least ten repeats at each of five calibration points
A report covering residuals, uncertainty, drift, and cross-sensitivity or disconnect failure

zh: 保留校准点的归一化 RMSE 低于满量程 2%，或按参考不确定度声明阈值
覆盖零点、满量程、越界、饱和、断线和环境极值
用第二种拟合/参考方法交叉核对灵敏度与偏置，差异落入合成不确定度
注入线性漂移和 5% 交叉敏感，量化补偿前后误差并证明告警触发
en: Keep held-out normalized RMSE below 2% of full scale or declare a threshold from reference uncertainty
Cover zero, full scale, out-of-range, saturation, disconnect, and environmental extremes
Cross-check sensitivity and offset with a second fit or reference method within combined uncertainty
Inject linear drift and 5% cross-sensitivity, quantify before and after compensation, and show the alarm triggers

zh: 提交接线/数据模型、采集、校准、检测、测试和绘图源文件
固定传感器/仪器型号、采样参数、环境、依赖和种子
保存原始测量/合成数据、校准证据、校验和与自动报告
en: Commit wiring or data model, acquisition, calibration, detection, test, and plotting sources
Pin sensor and instrument models, acquisition parameters, environment, dependencies, and seeds
Preserve raw measurement or synthetic data, calibration evidence, checksums, and the generated report

safety_note.zh: 实体传感器仅限隔离、限流且不高于 5 V；核对输入和连接器额定值，断电接线，不接人体、市电、压力容器、热源或运动机械。
safety_note.en: Limit physical sensors to isolated, current-limited operation at or below 5 V; verify input and connector ratings and wire with power removed. No human, mains, pressure-vessel, heat-source, or moving-machine connection.

title.en: Sensors and Sensor Circuit Design · University of Colorado Boulder ECEA 5340: Sensor Calibration, Drift, and Uncertainty Validation

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Sensors and Sensor Circuit Design · University of Colorado Boulder ECEA 5340》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。为传感器与仪器使用低压传感器或合成数据建立校准曲线、漂移模型和不确定度预算，并验证断线、饱和和交叉敏感。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Sensors and Sensor Circuit Design · University of Colorado Boulder ECEA 5340, not an official course assignment. Use a low-voltage sensor or synthetic data for Sensors and Instrumentation to build calibration and drift models with an uncertainty budget and test disconnect, saturation, and cross-sensitivity.

zh: 量程、分辨率、采样、参考量、环境和不确定度目标规格
采集/生成、校准拟合、漂移补偿和故障检测源文件
至少 5 个校准点各 10 次重复的原始数据、时间/环境记录
一份报告，给出残差、不确定度、漂移和交叉敏感/断线失败
en: A specification for range, resolution, acquisition, reference, environment, and uncertainty target
Acquisition or generation, calibration fit, drift compensation, and fault-detection sources
Raw data, time, and environment records for at least ten repeats at each of five calibration points
A report covering residuals, uncertainty, drift, and cross-sensitivity or disconnect failure

zh: 保留校准点的归一化 RMSE 低于满量程 2%，或按参考不确定度声明阈值
覆盖零点、满量程、越界、饱和、断线和环境极值
用第二种拟合/参考方法交叉核对灵敏度与偏置，差异落入合成不确定度
注入线性漂移和 5% 交叉敏感，量化补偿前后误差并证明告警触发
en: Keep held-out normalized RMSE below 2% of full scale or declare a threshold from reference uncertainty
Cover zero, full scale, out-of-range, saturation, disconnect, and environmental extremes
Cross-check sensitivity and offset with a second fit or reference method within combined uncertainty
Inject linear drift and 5% cross-sensitivity, quantify before and after compensation, and show the alarm triggers

zh: 提交接线/数据模型、采集、校准、检测、测试和绘图源文件
固定传感器/仪器型号、采样参数、环境、依赖和种子
保存原始测量/合成数据、校准证据、校验和与自动报告
en: Commit wiring or data model, acquisition, calibration, detection, test, and plotting sources
Pin sensor and instrument models, acquisition parameters, environment, dependencies, and seeds
Preserve raw measurement or synthetic data, calibration evidence, checksums, and the generated report

safety_note.zh: 实体传感器仅限隔离、限流且不高于 5 V；核对输入和连接器额定值，断电接线，不接人体、市电、压力容器、热源或运动机械。
safety_note.en: Limit physical sensors to isolated, current-limited operation at or below 5 V; verify input and connector ratings and wire with power removed. No human, mains, pressure-vessel, heat-source, or moving-machine connection.

title.en: Biomedical Instrumentation · IIT Madras / NPTEL 102106669: Public/Synthetic Biomedical Signal Algorithm Audit

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Biomedical Instrumentation · IIT Madras / NPTEL 102106669》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。围绕生物医学电子与信号仅用公开且去标识或合成数据实现信号/图像算法，审查性能、亚组切片、伪影和分布外失败；不采集人体数据。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Biomedical Instrumentation · IIT Madras / NPTEL 102106669, not an official course assignment. Implement a signal or image algorithm for Biomedical Electronics and Signals using only public de-identified or synthetic data, auditing performance, subgroup slices, artifacts, and out-of-distribution failure; collect no human data.

zh: 任务、非临床用途、数据来源/许可、去标识状态和指标预注册
数据校验、预处理、基线、改进算法与自动测试源文件
固定划分上的原始预测、标签/合成真值、伪影和切片指标
一份模型卡式报告，含不确定度、错误案例、公平性限制和禁止用途
en: A preregistration of task, nonclinical purpose, data provenance and license, de-identification status, and metrics
Data validation, preprocessing, baseline, improved algorithm, and automated test sources
Raw predictions, labels or synthetic truth, artifacts, and slice metrics on fixed splits
A model-card-style report covering uncertainty, error cases, fairness limitations, and prohibited uses

zh: 在锁定测试集上优于简单基线，并为主要指标给出 95% bootstrap 区间
覆盖全零/缺失通道、幅值饱和、工频伪影和分布外合成样本
用第二个实现交叉核对至少 20 个样本的预处理和指标
按公开元数据的非敏感技术切片报告最差组，不声称临床有效性
en: Beat a simple baseline on a locked test set and report 95% bootstrap intervals for primary metrics
Cover all-zero or missing channels, amplitude saturation, line-noise artifacts, and synthetic out-of-distribution samples
Cross-check preprocessing and metrics on at least 20 samples with an independent implementation
Report the worst non-sensitive technical slice available in public metadata without claiming clinical validity

zh: 提交数据获取清单、校验、预处理、模型、评估和报告源文件
固定公开数据版本/哈希、划分、环境、依赖、种子和模型参数
保存许可允许的原始或派生数据索引、预测、日志与自动报告
en: Commit data-acquisition manifest, validation, preprocessing, model, evaluation, and report sources
Pin public-data version or hashes, splits, environment, dependencies, seeds, and model parameters
Preserve license-permitted raw or derived data indexes, predictions, logs, and the generated report

safety_note.zh: 只能使用公开去标识或合成数据，不指导或进行人体采集，不连接电极/传感器到人体，也不得用于诊断、治疗或临床决策。
safety_note.en: Use only public de-identified or synthetic data; do not instruct or perform human data collection, connect electrodes or sensors to people, or use results for diagnosis, treatment, or clinical decisions.

summary.zh: MIT 的《Biomedical Signal and Image Processing》以讲义、实验和 MATLAB 工作流补充生物医学信号与图像处理；内容仍有价值，但工具链和旧数据链接需要迁移。

Implement a signal or image algorithm for Biomedical Electronics and Signals using only public de-identified or synthetic data, auditing performance, subgroup slices, artifacts, and out-of-distribution failure; collect no human data.

zh: 任务、非临床用途、数据来源/许可、去标识状态和指标预注册
数据校验、预处理、基线、改进算法与自动测试源文件
固定划分上的原始预测、标签/合成真值、伪影和切片指标
一份模型卡式报告，含不确定度、错误案例、公平性限制和禁止用途
en: A preregistration of task, nonclinical purpose, data provenance and license, de-identification status, and metrics
Data validation, preprocessing, baseline, improved algorithm, and automated test sources
Raw predictions, labels or synthetic truth, artifacts, and slice metrics on fixed splits
A model-card-style report covering uncertainty, error cases, fairness limitations, and prohibited uses

zh: 在锁定测试集上优于简单基线，并为主要指标给出 95% bootstrap 区间
覆盖全零/缺失通道、幅值饱和、工频伪影和分布外合成样本
用第二个实现交叉核对至少 20 个样本的预处理和指标
按公开元数据的非敏感技术切片报告最差组，不声称临床有效性
en: Beat a simple baseline on a locked test set and report 95% bootstrap intervals for primary metrics
Cover all-zero or missing channels, amplitude saturation, line-noise artifacts, and synthetic out-of-distribution samples
Cross-check preprocessing and metrics on at least 20 samples with an independent implementation
Report the worst non-sensitive technical slice available in public metadata without claiming clinical validity

zh: 提交数据获取清单、校验、预处理、模型、评估和报告源文件
固定公开数据版本/哈希、划分、环境、依赖、种子和模型参数
保存许可允许的原始或派生数据索引、预测、日志与自动报告
en: Commit data-acquisition manifest, validation, preprocessing, model, evaluation, and report sources
Pin public-data version or hashes, splits, environment, dependencies, seeds, and model parameters
Preserve license-permitted raw or derived data indexes, predictions, logs, and the generated report

safety_note.zh: 只能使用公开去标识或合成数据，不指导或进行人体采集，不连接电极/传感器到人体，也不得用于诊断、治疗或临床决策。
safety_note.en: Use only public de-identified or synthetic data; do not instruct or perform human data collection, connect electrodes or sensors to people, or use results for diagnosis, treatment, or clinical decisions.

summary.zh: University of California, Berkeley 的《Analog Integrated Circuits》以 2025 年 21 份公开讲义、10 份作业、部分当前答案、历年已解考试、8 个实验和一项模拟 IC 设计项目构成高强度主线；课程从单级与差分放大器推进到稳定性补偿、偏置、折叠共栅、开关电容、ADC、比较器与噪声。
summary.en: University of California, Berkeley's Analog Integrated Circuits forms a demanding analog-IC spine from twenty-one public 2025 lecture decks, ten homework sets, partial current solutions, archived solved exams, eight laboratories, and a design project, progressing from single-stage and differential amplifiers through compensation, biasing, folded cascodes, switched capacitors, ADCs, comparators, and noise.

note.zh: 提供方公布 15 周；上方每周工时是维护者规划估计，依据课程角色与公开练习、实验密度生成，不是提供方承诺。先试学两周，若实际偏差超过 25%，据实调整。
note.en: The provider publishes 15 weeks; the weekly effort above is a maintainer planning estimate derived from course role and public practice/lab density, not a provider promise. Pilot two weeks and adjust when actual effort differs by more than 25%.

zh: 维护者建议的开源/免费验证路径：xschem、ngspice、KLayout、Magic，以及教程明确支持的开放 PDK
资源清单未标注公开代码覆盖；上述工具仅用于维护者建议的独立验证，不代表提供方要求
en: Maintainer-suggested open-source/free verification path: xschem, ngspice, KLayout, Magic, and an open PDK explicitly supported by the tutorial
The resource inventory does not list public code coverage; the tools above are only a maintainer-suggested independent check, not a provider requirement

zh: 资源清单包含实验覆盖；维护者路径将其按计算/仿真实验处理，除非提供方实验手册另有明确说明。只假设可运行 PDK、角落仿真和版图检查的计算机；不假设流片或实体芯片。提供方如另列设备或算力要求，以其课程页面为准
en: The resource inventory lists lab coverage; the maintainer path treats it as computational/simulation work unless the provider lab manual explicitly says otherwise. It assumes only a computer that can run the PDK, corner simulations, and layout checks; no tape-out or physical chip is assumed. If the provider lists different equipment or compute requirements, follow its course page

cost_note.zh: 建议软件栈可开源或免费使用；这只是维护者规划，不是提供方要求。商业许可证、云计算、存储和机构资源如被提供方指定，其费用随方案、地区与机构而变，本文不设固定价格。
cost_note.en: The suggested software stack is available open source or free; this is maintainer planning, not a provider requirement. If the provider specifies commercial licenses, cloud compute, storage, or institutional resources, costs vary by plan, region, and institution, so no fixed price is asserted here.

note.zh: 默认实践范围仅限软件、计算或仿真；不得因资源清单中的“实验”标签自行连接实体设备，任何硬件扩展都必须重新核对提供方范围并进行风险评估。
note.en: The default practice scope is software, computation, or simulation only; a lab label in the resource inventory does not authorize connecting physical equipment, and any hardware extension requires provider-scope verification and a new risk assessment.

zh: 建议先完成方向基础：微电子学
建议先完成方向基础：模拟电子
课程顺序要求：先完成《Microelectronic Devices and Circuits》（University of California, Berkeley EE 105）
en: Recommended foundation: Microelectronics
Recommended foundation: Analog Electronics
Course-sequence requirement: complete Microelectronic Devices and Circuits (University of California, Berkeley EE 105) first

zh: 解释模拟与混合信号集成电路中的核心模型，并说明主要假设与适用边界
独立完成代表性推导与题目，并用量纲、极限情形或数值结果交叉检查
完成可复现实验或实现，保留原始数据、参数、版本和验证记录
en: Explain the core models in Analog and Mixed-Signal IC Design, including their assumptions and limits
Solve representative derivations and problems, checking units, limiting cases, or numerical results
Complete a reproducible experiment or implementation with raw data, parameters, versions, and verification

zh: 按周学习日志：投入时间、问题、错误订正、决策、下一步，并链接本周可复现产物
设计审查包：需求与约束、方案权衡、可编辑源文件、适用的 ERC/DRC/时序/稳定性检查、导出物与复现实验
仿真包：模型或网表、输入、求解器与版本、参数扫描脚本、基准对照、预期结果及一条重新运行命令
en: Weekly learning log with time, questions, corrected errors, decisions, next steps, and links to that week's reproducible artifacts
Design-review package with requirements and constraints, trade-offs, editable sources, applicable ERC/DRC/timing/stability checks, exports, and a reproduction test
Simulation package with model or netlist, inputs, solver and version, parameter-sweep script, benchmark comparison, expected results, and one rerun command

selection_note.zh: 主线课程，核心内容可靠，适合按自身背景作为主课或高质量替代。（审阅记录：A content / B tooling）
selection_note.en: Mainline course. A reliable option that can serve as a main course or strong alternative. Review note: A content / B tooling

review_note.zh: 官方先修是 EE 105（现有课程 ID 31）。Lab 1 可用 LTspice；Lab 2–8 与项目依赖伯克利 Cadence/Virtuoso 服务器和 SKY130 环境。Razavi 或 Gray 教材需付费，页面未声明可再分发许可。EEDIY 可以链接原资料并给出模拟主线，但在独立验证开源 PDK/EDA 移植前，不能声称完整实验可在校外复现。
review_note.en: The official prerequisite is EE 105 (existing course ID 31). Lab 1 uses LTspice; Labs 2–8 and the project depend on Berkeley's Cadence/Virtuoso servers and SKY130 environment. The Razavi or Gray text is paid and no redistribution license is stated. EEDIY may link the originals and teach the simulation spine, but must not claim full off-campus reproducibility until an open PDK/EDA port is independently validated.

title.zh: 《Analog Integrated Circuits · University of California, Berkeley EE 140 / EE 240A》运放/数据转换器规格闭环
title.en: Analog Integrated Circuits · University of California, Berkeley EE 140 / EE 240A: Op-Amp or Data-Converter Specification Closure

brief.zh: 这是维护者为《Analog Integrated Circuits · University of California, Berkeley EE 140 / EE 240A》建议的自学项目，不是课程官方作业。为模拟与混合信号集成电路完成一个运放或小型数据转换器的晶体管级规格闭环，覆盖稳定性、噪声、线性、PVT 与蒙特卡洛失配。
brief.en: This is a maintainer-suggested self-study project for Analog Integrated Circuits · University of California, Berkeley EE 140 / EE 240A, not an official course assignment. Close transistor-level specifications for an op-amp or compact data converter in Analog and Mixed-Signal IC Design, covering stability, noise, linearity, PVT, and mismatch Monte Carlo.

zh: 含负载/共模/输出摆幅/功耗/噪声的规格与测试台矩阵
晶体管级设计、偏置、所有测试台和自动规格提取脚本
标称、PVT 与至少 200 次失配蒙特卡洛的原始波形/指标
一份报告，给出规格良率、Pareto 取舍、最坏样本和修正
en: A specification and testbench matrix covering load, common mode, output swing, power, and noise
Transistor-level design, bias network, every testbench, and automated metric-extraction scripts
Raw waveforms and metrics for nominal, PVT, and at least 200 mismatch Monte Carlo runs
A report giving specification yield, Pareto tradeoffs, worst sample, and corrective change

zh: 标称条件全部关键规格通过，开环/闭环增益关系与手算相差低于 15%
覆盖共模与输出摆幅边界、最大电容负载、最低电源和温度极值
用噪声积分或 FFT 第二种方法交叉核对输入等效噪声/线性
蒙特卡洛规格良率达到预设目标，且能复现并解释最坏失败样本
en: Pass every primary nominal specification and keep hand-estimated versus simulated open or closed-loop gain within 15%
Cover common-mode and output-swing limits, maximum capacitive load, minimum supply, and temperature extremes
Cross-check input-referred noise or linearity through a second noise-integration or FFT method
Meet the predeclared Monte Carlo yield and reproduce and explain the worst failing sample

zh: 提交设计、偏置、测试台、规格提取与报告源文件
固定 PDK/模型、仿真器、角落、蒙特卡洛种子与容差
保存全部原始波形/指标、失败样本配置和自动报告
en: Commit design, bias, testbench, metric-extraction, and report sources
Pin PDK or models, simulator, corners, Monte Carlo seeds, and tolerances
Preserve all raw waveforms and metrics, failing-sample configurations, and the generated report

safety_note.zh: 仅做晶体管级仿真并遵守 PDK/模型许可；不进行流片、探针台、高压或未经授权的商业 EDA 操作。
safety_note.en: Use transistor-level simulation only and honor PDK or model licenses; no tape-out, probe-station, high-voltage, or unauthorized commercial-EDA activity.
